summary: AerCap Holdings N.V. and co-registrant subsidiaries filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement on 2026-09-25 under an existing shelf, a routine debt securities takedown rather than a special situation. The filing discloses no stake, price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or structural change such as a merger, tender, or buyback. Mechanics center on AerCap Aviation Solutions B.V. and affiliated issuers or guarantors registering notes. The risk-arb angle is absent; watch only for pricing terms, coupon, maturity, and use of proceeds once the supplement is complete.
